method: Selected dated reports and local source/fixture receipts only; these are documented incidents, not a measured incident rate or evidence that a skill was unused.

items.topic: Long hashes and extra message round trips
items.observedImpact: Verbose conversational checkpoint/status payloads and unnecessary probe/ack traffic consumed context; source guidance was tightened. No global token-cost measurement.

items.topic: Shared Claude job environment affected native titles
items.observedImpact: One rename produced same title on three distinct session records; subsequent launch isolation and guarded same-session recovery were required.

items.topic: Codex/Claude census staleness and inferred context
items.observedImpact: Context usage from last observed token event can be stale after later input or compaction; unknowns need explicit freshness rather than zero/current claims.
Transcript was absent before first turn, then only one skill was delivered, then aggregate model/effort mixed a Sonnet-overridden skill turn with Haiku base turns; no complete readiness receipt yet.
Runtime connection and firewall bridge proved the network chain, while declarative Horizon capability integration remained separate and unaccepted.

unknowns: Whether any installed skill was actually loaded in a given model turn without native expansion receipts
